subject: Mythology
title: The Morrigan: Goddess of War and Fate
description: A quick win: understand The Morrigan: Goddess of War and Fate.

hook.text: The Morrigan appeared as a crow over battlefields, choosing who would live and who would die that day.

buildup.text: She was a shapeshifter who could appear as a young woman, an old hag, or a terrifying war phantom.

discovery.text: Before major battles, she would wash the armor of warriors fated to die in a river, signaling their doom.

twist.text: She offered the hero Cu Chulainn her love. When he rejected her, she became his most dangerous enemy.

climax.text: When Cu Chulainn finally died, the Morrigan landed on his shoulder as a crow, claiming him at last.

punchline.text: The goddess of war always gets what she wants — eventually.

quiz.question: What did the Morrigan do before a battle to signal a warrior's doom?
options: She appeared in their dreams as a warning
She washed the armor of those fated to die in a river
She placed a curse mark on their weapons
